question: Should this maintainer-requested Matrix client refactor merge after a refreshed head and real Matrix runtime proof for the moved sync and crypto lifecycle paths?
rationale: The PR is protected by the `maintainer` label and reorganizes stateful channel runtime code; automated checks establish useful confidence but do not settle the runtime and upgrade behavior of a real encrypted Matrix session.

options.title: Refresh and prove runtime behavior
options.body: Rebase the branch and add redacted evidence from a real Matrix startup/sync plus encrypted-event or verification/recovery flow before merging.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A Matrix owner may explicitly accept the residual runtime risk based on the focused test suite and green checks.

options.title: Narrow or defer the refactor
options.body: Pause the broad structural change if current Matrix maintenance needs a smaller, independently demonstrable split first.

recommendation.title: Refresh and prove runtime behavior
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch and add redacted evidence from a real Matrix startup/sync plus encrypted-event or verification/recovery flow before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence directly ties this person to the proposed hierarchy and its stated ownership boundaries.
